title: Affirmative Action in India with Hierarchical Reservations
abstract: arXiv:2602.09189v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We study the design of affirmative action mechanisms, focusing on India's system of horizontal reservations within vertical reservations. We consider a one-to-all policy, under which an applicant eligible for multiple horizontal categories simultaneously contributes toward each category's minimum guarantee. When horizontal reservations have a hierarchical structure, we introduce a choice rule that selects the unique merit-optimal set of applicants subject to these guaranties, satisfies the substitutes condition and size monotonicity. In a matching-with-contracts framework, we show that the generalized deferred acceptance mechanism is stable, strategy-proof, and eliminates justified envy under aggregate choice rules using the hierarchical choice rule in each vertical category. We establish a fundamental trade-off between merit and affirmative action between the one-to-all and one-to-one counting policies.

translated_title: 印度具有层级保留配额的平权行动机制设计
translated_abstract: 我们研究平权行动机制的设计，重点关注印度在纵向保留配额内嵌套横向保留配额的体系。我们考虑一种“一对多”计数政策，在该政策下，符合多个横向类别资格的申请人可以同时计入每个类别的最低保障名额。当横向保留配额具有层级结构时，我们引入了一种选择规则，该规则在这些保障约束下选出唯一的按成绩最优的申请人集合，并满足可替代性条件和规模单调性。在带合同的匹配框架中，我们证明了在各纵向类别中使用该层级选择规则的聚合选择规则时，广义延迟接受机制是稳定的、防策略操纵的，并能消除正当嫉妒。我们还建立了“一对多”与“一对一”两种计数政策之间在成绩与平权行动之间的根本性权衡。
tldr: 该论文针对印度纵向与横向保留配额嵌套的层级结构，提出了一种满足可替代性与规模单调性的层级选择规则，证明基于该规则的广义延迟接受机制稳定、防操纵且无正当嫉妒，并揭示了“一对多”与“一对一”计数政策下成绩与平权行动之间的根本权衡。
